import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('repo-releases')

@mcp.tool()
def delete_release_tag(db_path: str, tag: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute('DELETE FROM releases WHERE tag = ?', (tag,))
            conn.execute(
                'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deleted_tags '
                '(tag TEXT, deleted_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)'
            )
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO deleted_tags (tag) VALUES (?)', (tag,))
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM release_assets WHERE tag = ?', (tag,))
    return f'Removed {cur.rowcount} release record(s) for tag {tag}'
